projects.title: Matrimonial Assistance
projects.content:
CBF allocates a sum of Rs. 400,000/- per month in order to assist young women from under-privileged homes in the process of their matrimonial arrangements. The monthly target in relation to this initiative is 20. A maximum sum of Rs. 20,000/- is paid to every applicant, however candidates are required to register their Nikah (Muslim Religious Ceremony under Islamic Law) with CBF at least 2-3 months ahead of their respective arranged dates of marriage.

All applications are reviewed by an Executive Panel and submitted to the Committee of Management for final approval.

projects.title: Qard Hasana Loans
projects.content:
This scheme, which as indicated in its title ‘Qard Hasan’ translates as ‘Benevolent Loan’, is an Islamic finance title referring to an interest free loan. In simple terms, the borrower is obliged to repay the principal sum of the loan without interest, mark-up or a share in the business for which the loan was utilized.

CBF offers Qard Hasan loans for sums ranging from Rs. 25,000/- to Rs. 100,000/-

CBF accepts gold jewellery as collateral at a rate of Rs. 50,000/- per sovereign. *

Repayment schemes usually endure a period of 10 months in equal installments.

*Values indicated for gold sovereign are at 22 carats.

projects.title: Emergency Relief
projects.content:
CBF takes great pride in its ability to deploy relief aid to communities in dire need of assistance, particularly in times of strife such as conflicts, natural disasters and pandemics.

In 2021, CBF initiated an Emergency Relief Programme at the height of the 3rd Covid-19 wave. Through dedication and perseverance, CBF was able to render relief assistance at a value of Rs. 9.37M to a total of 3083 families from the four corners of Sri Lanka, namely:

  1. Colombo
  2. Badulla
  3. Kandy
  4. Hambantota
  5. Matara
  6. Batticaloa
